A standalone macOS menu bar app for your Akahu accounts. Requires macOS 15 or later and Touch ID.

Download the ZIP for your Mac: `arm64` for Apple silicon, `x86_64` for Intel. Extract Reckon.app, move it to Applications, open it, and connect your own Akahu tokens. Tokens and bank history are not included.

This personal build is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS Gatekeeper may require approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security. On managed Macs it may be blocked. A Mac without Touch ID cannot unlock Reckon.

SHA-256 checksum files accompany each archive. GitHub release access follows the repository's visibility.
